inspection_summary: Verified the frozen 879-line source and inspected every line. The article develops a connected picture of zeros of zeta derivatives: a Speiser-type RH equivalence and zero-count comparison for zeta prime, Littlewood-lemma counts and first moments for higher derivatives, reflected auxiliary-function comparisons across the critical line, quantitative left-tail control by chains of boxes, and inheritance of left-half-plane zero finiteness under differentiation. Five v1 units remain immutable; thirteen additional units recover theorem statements, proof conclusions, auxiliary transformations, and corollaries omitted by the v1 spans. Formula OCR is locally damaged, so formula-dependent units are retained only where the surrounding checked prose and downstream use make the mechanism recoverable, with scan verification explicitly requested.

sections_inspected.label: 1. Introduction and some results
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States zero-count, clustering, moment, left-right comparison, density, inheritance, and RH-conditional results for derivatives of zeta.

sections_inspected.label: 2. Proof of Theorem 1 and consequences
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Uses the logarithmic derivative, functional-equation symmetry, boundary sign control, and the argument principle; then treats negative real zeros and introduces a reflected auxiliary function for numerical location.

sections_inspected.label: 3. Proofs of Theorems 2 and 3
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Normalizes higher derivatives, applies Littlewood's lemma, evaluates the far-left boundary via the functional equation and Stirling asymptotics, and derives total counts, concentration, and signed first moments.

sections_inspected.label: 4. Proofs of Theorems 4 and 5
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Transfers derivative zeros through a reflected auxiliary function, bounds a logarithmic integral with a fractional-moment lemma, and combines left-right displacement control with the signed moment.

sections_inspected.label: 5. Proof of Theorem 6
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Builds boxes around right-side zeta zeros, groups protruding boxes into chains, applies Littlewood's lemma on chain rectangles, and converts Selberg-type density input into left-tail bounds for zeta-prime zeros.

sections_inspected.label: 6. Proofs of Theorems 7 and 8
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Uses a partial-fraction/logarithmic-derivative sign argument to propagate finiteness of left-side nonreal zeros to higher derivatives, then specializes the earlier moment formula under RH.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Reflection transfers horizontal displacement between zeta and zeta prime

within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The auxiliary function is source-specific, and the extracted defining formulas need scan verification.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Right-side zeta density controls the left tail of zeta-prime zeros
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Boxes around right-side zeta zeros identify where logarithmic-derivative positivity can fail; chaining overlapping protruding boxes and applying Littlewood's lemma only on those rectangles converts a density estimate for zeta zeros into quantitative and qualitative scarcity of far-left zeta-prime zeros.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: RH information propagates through the derivative tower
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: If one derivative has only finitely many nonreal zeros left of the critical line, the increasingly negative contribution from its real zeros forces the next logarithmic derivative to be nonzero there at large height; induction propagates the property, and the signed moment formula then becomes a one-sided RH-conditional asymptotic.
